sidebar.welcomeHint: Select a game from your library to see its details, or press Play to launch it directly.

tips.windowed: Start windowed — the most cited fix for hangs/freezes caused by exclusive fullscreen under Wine/Proton
tips.noborder: Borderless window — combined with -windowed for a "fullscreen" without the problems of exclusive fullscreen
tips.dx9: Force DirectX 9 — often fewer quirks under Wine/DXVK than later versions of the same game
tips.nointro: Skip the intro videos — a frequent cause of crashes under Wine because of codec problems
tips.novid: Like -nointro, Source engine variant (Half-Life 2, CS:S, TF2, Portal, Left 4 Dead)
tips.high: High process priority — suggested for stutter in Source/older games
tips.nojoy: Disable the game's joystick detection — useful if it conflicts with the Dashboard's controller detection
tips.retroarchCrt: Ready-to-use CRT filter (crt-easymode) — --appendconfig= turns out to be ignored by RetroArch, this is the flag verified to work
tips.retroarchVerbose: Verbose log — the first step to diagnose a core or a ROM that won't start
tips.retroarchMaxFrames: Closes RetroArch after N frames — only useful for automated tests, not for normal use
tips.winedebug: Silences Wine's debug log — less noise, slightly less overhead
tips.wineesync: Enable esync — lighter synchronization, useful on older kernels
tips.winefsync: Enable fsync — the more modern equivalent of esync, recent kernels
tips.wineLargeAddressAware: Lets 32-bit games use more than 2 GB of RAM — a widely cited fix
tips.winemenubuilder: Stops Wine from automatically creating shortcuts/menu entries
tips.d3d11Native: Force the native DLL instead of the built-in one — useful for specific graphics problems
tips.protonLog: Enable Proton logging to file — the first step of any diagnosis
tips.protonNoEsync: Disable esync — sometimes needed for compatibility
tips.protonNoFsync: Disable fsync — same reason as NO_ESYNC
tips.protonWined3d: Force WineD3D instead of DXVK/VKD3D — useful if DXVK has specific problems
tips.protonLargeAddressAware: Proton equivalent of the RAM fix for 32-bit games
tips.dxvkHud: DXVK overlay with on-screen FPS — quick diagnostics, changes nothing
tips.dxvkAsync: Reduces shader compilation stutter — one of the most cited fixes of all

notif.launchBlockedBody: The {{store}} plugin is disabled and requires DRM to launch. Re-enable it in Settings → Plugins.

notif.switchToDesktopBody: X-Launcher stays running in the background — come back here from XFCE's user menu.

launcherDescriptions.ea_app_launcher: EA App launcher — required by some EA games bought on Epic, GOG, Amazon Games, or Steam. Install it once: it'll be shared by every game that requires it.
launcherDescriptions.ubisoft_connect_launcher: Ubisoft Connect launcher — required by some Ubisoft games bought on Epic, GOG, or Amazon Games. Install it once: it'll be shared by every game that requires it.
launcherDescriptions.steam_bigpicture_launcher: Switch to Steam in Big Picture mode, with your full Steam library and Valve's native controller-first interface.
